fields.label: Target Rule
fields.description: Must be submitted and marked Customer Visible.

fields.label: Show From
fields.description: STOREFRONT DISPLAY date, inclusive. Unrelated to the Target Period (which sales count) and to the Report Window (when recalculation runs).

fields.label: Show Until
fields.description: STOREFRONT DISPLAY date, inclusive. After it the block stops exposing this target; the target itself is unaffected.
